what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect amount is a count of a creature's power (Count$CardPower) while that power is negative: the amount applied equals zero, not the negative number.
near_miss: The same count-of-power effect resolving while the creature's power is positive, applying its full power.
record_fields: resolution payload events (pt_change / damage_dealt / life_change amount)

what_to_detect: A combat in which a creature whose power is zero or less is a declared attacker or blocker and the combat events hold no damage_dealt from it (and no life gained by the opponent).
near_miss: A combat where a creature with positive power deals damage.

what_to_detect: A resolution of an ability whose amount is defined by the ability's own text (Count$...) where the applied amount equals the value the count has at resolution, not at activation.
near_miss: The same ability resolving with the count unchanged since activation.
record_fields: cost half state vs effect half state

what_to_detect: A trigger that refers to the X of another object (the cast spell that triggered it) firing, with the effect using the X that object was cast with.
near_miss: A trigger referring to another object's X whose effect amount is not the X that object was cast with.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose amount derives from the mana value of a card with {X} in its cost that is outside the stack, applying X = 0.
near_miss: The same effect applied to a spell on the stack, with X as announced.
record_fields: state.entities mana_value of the card outside the stack

what_to_detect: A decision candidate paying a mana cost of an object outside the stack that has {X}, treated as X = 0 (candidate affordable).
near_miss: A candidate whose cost-paid object has no {X}.
record_fields: gen-3 card mana_cost of the exiled card

what_to_detect: A resolution of an ability a copy gained, whose X is the activation's X, not the copied card's X.
near_miss: A gained activated ability with {X} whose effect uses the copied or copying object's X instead of the X announced for the activation.

what_to_detect: A resolution of an activated ability with {X} in its cost, whose amount equals the X announced in that activation, independent of the X the permanent was cast with.
near_miss: An activated ability with {X} whose amount follows the X the permanent was cast with instead of the X announced for this activation.
record_fields: gen-3 card x_paid of the source permanent

what_to_detect: A permanent entering the battlefield with counters whose number equals the X of the spell that became the permanent.
near_miss: A permanent entering without having been cast (X = 0, no counters).
record_fields: resolution payload events (zone_change to battlefield, counter_change delta)

what_to_detect: An enters-the-battlefield trigger whose effect repeats or scales by the X of the spell that became the permanent.
near_miss: The same trigger when the permanent was put onto the battlefield without being cast (X = 0).

what_to_detect: A delayed triggered ability created by a spell whose effect count equals the X of the spell that created it.
near_miss: A delayed trigger whose effect count is not the X of the spell that created it.
record_fields: state.refs.x of the delayed trigger's resolution

what_to_detect: A spell with {X} in its mana cost cast without paying that cost, resolving with X = 0.
near_miss: The same spell cast paying its cost with X announced.

what_to_detect: A triggered ability a Class gains at a level fires while the Class is at that level or greater.
near_miss: The trigger's event happens while the Class is below the level that grants the trigger, so the trigger is not on the Class at all and is never evaluated.
record_fields: the Class keyword's line (K:Class:N:cost:AddTrigger$), which a static adds only from level N
gen-3 line flag 'active' (Class level reached, in.line_flags / new:class_level)
the event's own records while the Class is below level N
